_comment: Template: Compare two CGMES instance-data model sets.
_how_to_use: Copy to your working directory. Replace REPLACE_WITH_PATH values. Run: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar compare-instances --config this-file.json
_note_modelsA: First (before / reference) model set. All files are merged into one combined graph. Accepts .xml, .rdf, .ttl, or .zip containing RDF/XML.
_note_modelsB: Second (after / changed) model set. Same format as modelsA.
_note_xmlBase: Base URI for parsing RDF/XML files. For CGMES 3.0/CIM17: http://iec.ch/TC57/CIM100. For CGMES 2.4/CIM16: http://iec.ch/TC57/2013/CIM-schema-cim16.
_note_ignoreSv: true to ignore SvVoltage, SvPowerFlow, SvInjection, SvStatus, SvSwitch, SvTapStep, SvShuntCompensatorSections, TopologicalIsland. Useful when comparing EQ models across time steps where power-flow results differ.
_note_ignoreTp: true to ignore TP (topology) profile differences.
_note_ignoreDl: true to ignore DL (diagram layout) profile differences.
_note_output: Where to write the diff report. Use .xlsx for Excel (recommended); any other extension for CSV. Remove this field to print to stdout instead.
_note_format: Only used when 'output' is not set. Options: text (pipe-separated table), json, csv.
